@@ -40,0 +42,7 @@
+
+func getUser(db *sql.DB, name string) (*User, error) {
+	query := "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"
+	row := db.QueryRow(query)
+	var u User
+	err := row.Scan(&u.ID, &u.Name, &u.Email)
+	return &u, err
+}
